######## Final processing ##########
Bam files contains lot of PCR duplicates (seen when creating fragment files)
So plan is to : 
 - Create Fragment file per sample using the bam 
 - Filter bad cells ??
 - Call peaks per sample ?

```{r Create Fragment file per sample}
library(parallel)

# --- Paths and parameters ---
maindir        <- "/Users/gjouault/Documents/Institut_Curie/Projects/Collabs/ChIC_Perie"
bam_dir        <- file.path(maindir, "Input", "Bams")

frag_dir_raw   <- file.path(maindir, "Input", "Fragments_raw")  # raw counts, plain TSV
frag_dir_bin   <- file.path(maindir, "Input", "Fragments_bin")  # binarized, bgzip + tabix

dir.create(frag_dir_raw, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(frag_dir_bin, showWarnings = FALSE)

# BAM files
bam_files_full  <- list.files(bam_dir, pattern = ".bam$", full.names = TRUE)
bam_files_short <- gsub("(.*).bam", "\\1",
                        list.files(bam_dir, pattern = ".bam$", full.names = FALSE))

# --- Parallel fragment generation loop ---
mclapply(seq_along(bam_files_short), function(i) {
  
  sample_path <- bam_files_full[i]
  sample_name <- bam_files_short[i]
  
  message("\n===== Creating fragment files for sample: ", sample_name, " =====")
  
  # RAW FRAGMENTS (with counts) - kept as sorted TSV only
  frag_unsorted_raw <- file.path(frag_dir_raw, paste0(sample_name, ".fragments.unsorted.tsv"))
  frag_sorted_raw   <- file.path(frag_dir_raw, paste0(sample_name, ".fragments.tsv"))
  log_file          <- file.path(frag_dir_raw, paste0(sample_name, "_sinto_fragments.log"))
  
  ## 1) sinto fragments: raw, with true counts
  cmd_sinto <- paste(
    "conda run -n Env_macs3 sinto fragments",
    "-f", shQuote(frag_unsorted_raw),
    "-b", shQuote(sample_path),
    "-p 2",
    "--barcodetag SM",
    "--use_chrom \"\"",
    "--shift_plus 0",
    "--shift_minus 0",
    "--collapse_within",
    ">",
    shQuote(log_file), "2>&1"
  )
  message("Running sinto: ", cmd_sinto)
  system(cmd_sinto)
  
  ## 2) sort raw fragments by chr, start
  cmd_sort_raw <- paste(
    "sort -k1,1 -k2,2n", shQuote(frag_unsorted_raw),
    ">",
    shQuote(frag_sorted_raw),
    "2>>", shQuote(log_file)
  )
  message("Running sort (raw): ", cmd_sort_raw)
  system(cmd_sort_raw)
  
  ## 3) remove unsorted intermediate
  unlink(frag_unsorted_raw)
  
  # BINARIZED FRAGMENTS (counts set to 1) - sorted, bgzip + tabix
  message("Creating binarized fragment file (PCR-dedup view) for sample: ", sample_name)
  
  frag_sorted_bin <- file.path(frag_dir_bin, paste0(sample_name, ".fragments.tsv"))
  frag_gz_bin     <- paste0(frag_sorted_bin, ".gz")
  
  # Set 5th column to 1 and add "chr" prefix to column 1 (if not already there)
  cmd_bin <- paste(
    "awk 'BEGIN{OFS=\"\\t\"} {",
      "if ($1 !~ /^chr/) $1 = \"chr\" $1;",  # add chr if missing
      "if (NF>=5) $5 = 1;",                  # binarize count
      "print",
    "}'",
    shQuote(frag_sorted_raw),
    ">",
    shQuote(frag_sorted_bin),
    "2>>", shQuote(log_file)
  )
  message("Running binarization + chr prefix: ", cmd_bin)
  system(cmd_bin)
  
  # bgzip + tabix on binarized file
  cmd_bgzip_bin <- paste(
    "bgzip -f", shQuote(frag_sorted_bin),
    "2>>", shQuote(log_file)
  )
  message("Running bgzip (bin): ", cmd_bgzip_bin)
  system(cmd_bgzip_bin)
  
  cmd_tabix_bin <- paste(
    "tabix -p bed", shQuote(frag_gz_bin),
    "2>>", shQuote(log_file)
  )
  message("Running tabix (bin): ", cmd_tabix_bin)
  system(cmd_tabix_bin)
  
  message("Finished raw + binarized fragment files for: ", sample_name)
  
}, mc.cores = 4)

```

```{r Get percentage of duplicates per sample}

bam_dir        <- file.path(maindir, "Input", "Bams")

frag_dir_raw   <- file.path(maindir, "Input", "Fragments_raw")  # raw counts, plain TSV

frag_files <- list.files(
  frag_dir_raw,
  pattern = "fragments.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Sample names = basename without .fragments.tsv
sample_names <- sub("\\.fragments\\.tsv$", "", basename(frag_files))

# --- Function to compute stats for one file ---
compute_fragment_stats <- function(file, sample_name) {
  message("Processing: ", sample_name, " (", file, ")")

  frag <- read.table(
    file,
    sep = "\t",
    header = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "cell", "count")
  )

  n_dedup_fragments <- nrow(frag)
  n_total_fragments <- sum(frag$count, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    sample            = sample_name,
    n_dedup_fragments = n_dedup_fragments,
    n_total_fragments = n_total_fragments,
    stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
  )
}

# --- Loop over all fragment files ---
stats_list <- mapply(
  compute_fragment_stats,
  file        = frag_files,
  sample_name = sample_names,
  SIMPLIFY    = FALSE
)

fragment_stats <- do.call(rbind, stats_list)

pdf(file.path(maindir, "Output", "Barplot_PCR_Duplicates_per_sample.pdf"), width = 9)
fragment_stats %>% mutate(n_unique = n_dedup_fragments, n_duplicated = n_total_fragments - n_dedup_fragments, prop_unique  = n_unique / n_total_fragments, prop_duplicated = n_duplicated / n_total_fragments) %>%  
  dplyr::select(sample, prop_unique, prop_duplicated) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(prop_unique, prop_duplicated),names_to = "type",values_to = "proportion") %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type, prop_unique = "Unique fragments", prop_duplicated = "Duplicated fragments")) %>% ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = proportion, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Proportion of fragments",
    fill = "",
    title = "Proportion of unique vs duplicated fragments per sample"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
     plot.margin  = margin(l = 40)
  )

fragment_stats %>% mutate(n_unique = n_dedup_fragments, n_duplicated = n_total_fragments - n_dedup_fragments, prop_unique  = n_unique / n_total_fragments, prop_duplicated = n_duplicated / n_total_fragments) %>%  
  dplyr::select(sample, n_unique, n_duplicated) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(n_unique,n_duplicated),names_to = "type",values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(type = recode(type, n_unique = "Unique fragments", n_duplicated = "Duplicated fragments")) %>% ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = count, fill = type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Number of fragments",
    fill = "",
    title = "Number of unique vs duplicated fragments per sample"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
    plot.margin  = margin(l = 40)
  )
dev.off()
```

```{r Use those Fragment files to create bw}
library(parallel)

#### --- Paths and parameters ---
maindir      <- "/Users/gjouault/Documents/Institut_Curie/Projects/Collabs/ChIC_Perie"

frag_dir     <- file.path(maindir, "Input", "Fragments")
bw_dir       <- file.path(maindir, "Input", "Bigwigs_from_fragments")
dir.create(bw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

chrom_sizes  <- file.path(maindir, "Annotations", "mm10.chrom.sizes")

# Fragment files: e.g. sample.fragments.tsv.gz
frag_files <- list.files(
  frag_dir,
  pattern = "\\.fragments\\.tsv\\.gz$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Sample names without extension
sample_names <- sub("\\.fragments\\.tsv\\.gz$", "", basename(frag_files))

#### --- Parallel loop: fragment -> bedGraph -> bigWig ---
mclapply(seq_along(frag_files), function(i) {
  
  frag_file     <- frag_files[i]
  sample_name   <- sample_names[i]
  
  message("\n===== Creating bigWig from fragments for sample: ", sample_name, " =====")
  
  bedgraph_file <- file.path(bw_dir, paste0(sample_name, ".bedGraph"))
  bw_file       <- file.path(bw_dir, paste0(sample_name, ".bw"))
  log_file      <- file.path(bw_dir, paste0(sample_name, "_frag2bw.log"))
  
  ## 1) zcat + cut + bedtools genomecov → bedGraph
  cmd_bg <- paste(
    "zcat", shQuote(frag_file),
    "| cut -f1-3",
    "| bedtools genomecov -i - -g", shQuote(chrom_sizes), "-bg",
    ">",
    shQuote(bedgraph_file),
    "2>",
    shQuote(log_file)
  )
  message("Running bedGraph generation: ", cmd_bg)
  system(cmd_bg)
  
  ## 2) bedGraphToBigWig → bigWig
  cmd_bw <- paste(
    "bedGraphToBigWig",
    shQuote(bedgraph_file),
    shQuote(chrom_sizes),
    shQuote(bw_file),
    "2>>",
    shQuote(log_file)
  )
  message("Running bedGraphToBigWig: ", cmd_bw)
  system(cmd_bw)
  
  ## (Optional) remove intermediate bedGraph
  # unlink(bedgraph_file)
  
  message("Finished bigWig for: ", sample_name)
  
}, mc.cores = 2)   # adjust cores if you like

```

```{r Get top 1K bins per sample to then use them to make DA and call motifs}
  #### Chromvar Analysis ###

genome_used <- BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10

#Use scExp_1K already computed 
sce <- scExp_1K  

# parse rownames: e.g. "chr2_98667001_98668000"
peak_strings <- rownames(sce)

peak_gr <- do.call("c", lapply(peak_strings, function(x) {
  parts <- strsplit(x, "_")[[1]]
  GRanges(
    seqnames = parts[1],
    ranges = IRanges(
      start = as.integer(parts[2]),
      end   = as.integer(parts[3])
    )
  )
}))

names(peak_gr) <- peak_strings

rowRanges(sce) <- peak_gr

# add GC content / peak width
sce <- addGCBias(sce, genome = genome_used)

# optional: filter out very low-signal peaks
sce <- filterPeaks(sce, min_fragments = 5)  # adjust threshold if needed

# get JASPAR TF motifs

                      ### Mouse motifs  ###

opts <- list(species = 10090, all_versions = FALSE) # mouse

motifs <- TFBSTools::getMatrixSet(JASPAR2020, opts)

# match motifs to peaks
# motifs <- getJasparMotifs(species = "Mus musculus")
motif_ix <- matchMotifs(
  motifs,
  rowRanges(sce),
  genome = genome_used
)

set.seed(1)

background_peaks <- getBackgroundPeaks(sce)

dev <- computeDeviations(
  object = sce,
  annotations = motif_ix,
  background_peaks = background_peaks
)
rownames(dev) <- paste(rownames(dev), rowData(dev)$name, sep = "_")
# per-cell motif deviation matrices:
motif_dev_raw <- deviations(dev)        # motif × cell, raw deviations
motif_dev_z   <- deviationScores(dev)   # motif × cell, z-scores (usually used)

diff_acc <- differentialDeviations(dev, "sample_id")

head(diff_acc[order(diff_acc$p_value_adjusted),], 10)
interesting_Tfs = rownames(diff_acc)[which(diff_acc$p_value_adjusted < 0.10)]

      #Make plots for interesting TFs 
motif_dev_z_tmp = motif_dev_z[interesting_Tfs,]
         df_plot_1K = cbind(as.data.frame(colData(scExp_1K)),as.data.frame(reducedDim(scExp_1K, "UMAP")), as.data.frame(t(motif_dev_z_tmp)))
  df_plot_1K = df_plot_1K[sample(1:nrow(df_plot_1K)), ]
    # 3) reshape to long format for all TFs
df_long <- df_plot_1K %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(interesting_Tfs),
    names_to = "TF",
    values_to = "deviation"
  )

# comparisons (you already have this)
my_comparisons <- list(
  c("CD62L-_stem_cells_no_drug_tagged",  "CD62L-_stem_cells_with_drug_tagged"),
  c("CD62L+_stem_cells_no_drug_tagged",  "CD62L+_stem_cells_with_drug_tagged")
)

# 4) plot: one boxplot per TF (facet)
p <- df_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_id, y = deviation, color = sample_id)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  theme_bw() +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons) +
  facet_wrap(~ TF, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

 pdf(file.path(maindir, "Output", "Boxplot_TFs_Deviation_MouseMotifs_Peaks_1Kbins_stem_cells.pdf"), width = 15, height = 15)
p
  
dev.off()

# match motifs to peaks
# motifs <- getJasparMotifs(species = "Mus musculus")
motif_ix <- matchMotifs(
  motifs,
  rowRanges(sce),
  genome = genome_used
)

set.seed(1)

background_peaks <- getBackgroundPeaks(sce)

dev <- computeDeviations(
  object = sce,
  annotations = motif_ix,
  background_peaks = background_peaks
)
rownames(dev) <- paste(rownames(dev), rowData(dev)$name, sep = "_")
# per-cell motif deviation matrices:
motif_dev_raw <- deviations(dev)        # motif × cell, raw deviations
motif_dev_z   <- deviationScores(dev)   # motif × cell, z-scores (usually used)

diff_acc <- differentialDeviations(dev, "sample_id")

head(diff_acc[order(diff_acc$p_value_adjusted),], 10)
interesting_Tfs = rownames(diff_acc)[which(diff_acc$p_value_adjusted < 0.20)]

      #Make plots for interesting TFs 
motif_dev_z_tmp = motif_dev_z[interesting_Tfs,]
         df_plot_1K = cbind(as.data.frame(colData(scExp_1K)),as.data.frame(reducedDim(scExp_1K, "UMAP")), as.data.frame(t(motif_dev_z_tmp)))
  df_plot_1K = df_plot_1K[sample(1:nrow(df_plot_1K)), ]
    # 3) reshape to long format for all TFs
df_long <- df_plot_1K %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(interesting_Tfs),
    names_to = "TF",
    values_to = "deviation"
  )


my_comparisons <- list(
  c("m61_m66_WT_62neg_tagged",  "m64_m68_Tg_62neg_tagged"),
  c("m61_m66_WT_62hi_tagged",  "m64_m68_Tg_62hi_tagged")
)

# 4) plot: one boxplot per TF (facet)
p <- df_long %>% mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = c("m61_m66_WT_62neg_tagged",  "m64_m68_Tg_62neg_tagged", "m61_m66_WT_62hi_tagged", "m64_m68_Tg_62hi_tagged"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_id, y = deviation, color = sample_id)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  theme_bw() +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons) +
  facet_wrap(~ TF, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

 pdf(file.path(maindir, "Output", "Boxplot_TFs_Deviation_MouseMotifs_Peaks_1Kbins_Mouse.pdf"), width = 15, height = 15)
p
  
dev.off()

   ### differential analysis ###
  
  ## Mouse_62neg_Tg_vs_WT
   scExp_1K_da = differential_analysis_scExp(scExp_1K, de_type = "custom", by = c("sample_id", "sample_id"),group = data.frame(group = c("m64_m68_Tg_62neg_tagged")), ref = data.frame(ref = c("m61_m66_WT_62neg_tagged")), prioritize_genes = F, method = "neg.binomial")
    DA = as.data.frame(rowData(scExp_1K_da))
    DA = DA %>% mutate(status = case_when(qval.group > 0.05 ~ "Not Sig",
                                                    abs(logFC.group) < 0.5 ~ "Not Sig",
                                        qval.group < 0.05 & logFC.group < -0.5 ~ "Down",
                                        qval.group < 0.05 & logFC.group > 0.5 ~ "Up"))
    pdf(file.path(maindir, "Output", "Volcano_Mouse_62neg_Tg_vs_WT.pdf"), width = 9)
    DA %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC.group, y = -log10(qval.group), fill = status)) + 
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.4, shape = 21, color = "black") +   
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype="dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype="dashed") +
   geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype="dashed") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightskyblue", "grey50", "tomato")) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(DA, -log10(qval.group) > 1.30103), aes(label = Gene), max.overlaps = 20, color = "black", size = 5) + 
    ggtitle("Volcano Plot - Mouse 62 neg - Tg vs WT")
    dev.off()
    
    write.csv(DA, file.path(maindir, "Output","Objects","DA_Mouse_62neg_Tg_vs_WT.csv"), row.names = F)
    
    ## Mouse_62hi_Tg_vs_WT
     scExp_1K_da = differential_analysis_scExp(scExp_1K, de_type = "custom", by = c("sample_id", "sample_id"),group = data.frame(group = c("m64_m68_Tg_62hi_tagged")), ref = data.frame(ref = c("m61_m66_WT_62hi_tagged")), prioritize_genes = F, method = "neg.binomial")
      DA = as.data.frame(rowData(scExp_1K_da))

                                          qval.group < 0.05 & logFC.group > 0.5 ~ "Up"))
      pdf(file.path(maindir, "Output", "Volcano_Mouse_62hi_Tg_vs_WT.pdf"), width = 9)
      DA %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = logFC.group, y = -log10(qval.group), fill = status)) +

    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype="dashed") +

meme_db = to_list(meme_db)

meme_db_jaspar = list()
file = list.files(file.path(maindir, "Annotations", "JASPAR2022_CORE_vertebrates_non-redundant_pfms_meme"))[1]

for (file in list.files(file.path(maindir, "Annotations", "JASPAR2022_CORE_vertebrates_non-redundant_pfms_meme"))){
  jaspar_to_add = read_meme(file.path(maindir, "Annotations", "JASPAR2022_CORE_vertebrates_non-redundant_pfms_meme", file))
  meme_db_jaspar = c(meme_db_jaspar, jaspar_to_add)
}
meme_db_jaspar = meme_db_jaspar %>%
  to_df() %>%
  mutate(name = paste0(altname, "_", name)) %>%
  to_list()
    
Motif_diff_UP = DA %>% dplyr::filter(logFC.group > 0.5 & qval.group < 0.05) %>% plyranges::as_granges() %>% memes::get_sequence(mm.genome) %>% unique()
Motif_diff_Down = DA %>% dplyr::filter(logFC.group < -0.5 & qval.group < 0.05) %>% plyranges::as_granges() %>% memes::get_sequence(mm.genome) %>% unique()
Background = DA %>% dplyr::filter(abs(logFC.group) < 0.2) %>% plyranges::as_granges() %>% memes::get_sequence(mm.genome) %>% unique() %>% sample(size = (10*max(length(Motif_diff_Down),length(Motif_diff_UP))))

AME_LP_HS1 = memes::runAme(Motif_diff_UP,control = Background, database = meme_db_jaspar)
head(AME_LP_HS1)
AME_LP_HS2 = memes::runAme(Motif_diff_UP,control = Background, database = meme_db)
head(AME_LP_HS2)
AME_LP_HS3 = memes::runAme(Motif_diff_Down,control = Background, database = meme_db_jaspar)
head(AME_LP_HS3)
```

```{r Get top 5K bins per sample to then use them to make DA and call motifs}
  df_plot_5K %>% ggplot(aes(x = Component_1, y = Component_2, fill = sample_id)) + geom_point(shape = 21, color = "grey70", size = 3) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") + theme_void() +

  ## Mouse_62neg_Tg_vs_WT
   scExp_5K_da = differential_analysis_scExp(scExp_5K, de_type = "custom", by = c("sample_id", "sample_id"),group = data.frame(group = c("m64_m68_Tg_62neg_tagged")), ref = data.frame(ref = c("m61_m66_WT_62neg_tagged")), prioritize_genes = F, method = "neg.binomial")
    DA = as.data.frame(rowData(scExp_5K_da))
    DA = DA %>% mutate(status = case_when(qval.group > 0.05 ~ "Not Sig",
                                                    abs(logFC.group) < 0.5 ~ "Not Sig",
                                        qval.group < 0.05 & logFC.group < -0.5 ~ "Down",
                                        qval.group < 0.05 & logFC.group > 0.5 ~ "Up"))
    pdf(file.path(maindir, "Output", "Volcano_Mouse_62neg_Tg_vs_WT_5Kbins.pdf"), width = 9)
    DA %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC.group, y = -log10(qval.group), fill = status)) + 
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.4, shape = 21, color = "black") +   
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype="dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype="dashed") +
   geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype="dashed") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightskyblue", "grey50", "tomato")) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(DA, -log10(qval.group) > 1.30103), aes(label = Gene), max.overlaps = 20, color = "black", size = 5) + 
    ggtitle("Volcano Plot - Mouse 62 neg - Tg vs WT")
    dev.off()
    
    write.csv(DA, file.path(maindir, "Output","Objects","DA_Mouse_62neg_Tg_vs_WT_5Kbins.csv"), row.names = F)

      pdf(file.path(maindir, "Output", "Volcano_Mouse_62hi_Tg_vs_WT_5Kbins.pdf"), width = 9)
      DA %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = logFC.group, y = -log10(qval.group), fill = status)) + 
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.4, shape = 21, color = "black") +   
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype="dashed") +
```

```{r Test : use ChromVAR}

# core
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(GenomicRanges)

# chromVAR
library(chromVAR)
library(motifmatchr)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)  # or your genome
library(JASPAR2020)
library(TFBSTools)

genome_used <- BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10

#Use scExp_1K already computed 
scExp_1K
sce <- scExp_1K   # just rename for convenience

# parse rownames: e.g. "chr2_98667001_98668000"
peak_strings <- rownames(sce)

peak_gr <- do.call("c", lapply(peak_strings, function(x) {
  parts <- strsplit(x, "_")[[1]]
  GRanges(
    seqnames = parts[1],
    ranges = IRanges(
      start = as.integer(parts[2]),
      end   = as.integer(parts[3])
    )
  )
}))

names(peak_gr) <- peak_strings

rowRanges(sce) <- peak_gr

# add GC content / peak width
sce <- addGCBias(sce, genome = genome_used)

# optional: filter out very low-signal peaks
sce <- filterPeaks(sce, min_fragments = 5)  # adjust threshold if needed

# get JASPAR TF motifs (human or mouse; species is not super critical,
# but you can match to your organism)
opts <- list(species = 9606, all_versions = FALSE)   # human
opts <- list(species = 10090, all_versions = FALSE) # mouse

motifs <- TFBSTools::getMatrixSet(JASPAR2020, opts)

# match motifs to peaks

motifs <- getJasparMotifs(species = "Mus musculus")
motif_ix <- matchMotifs(
  motifs,
  rowRanges(sce),
  genome = genome_used
)

set.seed(1)

background_peaks <- getBackgroundPeaks(sce)

dev <- computeDeviations(
  object = sce,
  annotations = motif_ix,
  background_peaks = background_peaks
)
rownames(dev) <- paste(rownames(dev), rowData(dev)$name, sep = "_")
# per-cell motif deviation matrices:
motif_dev_raw <- deviations(dev)        # motif × cell, raw deviations
motif_dev_z   <- deviationScores(dev)   # motif × cell, z-scores (usually used)

diff_acc <- differentialDeviations(dev, "sample_id")

head(diff_acc[order(diff_acc$p_value_adjusted),], 10)
interesting_Tfs = rownames(diff_acc)[which(diff_acc$p_value_adjusted < 0.05)]

diff_var <- differentialVariability(dev, "sample_id")

head(diff_var)

variability <- computeVariability(dev)
plotVariability(variability, use_plotly = FALSE)

sample_cor <- getSampleCorrelation(dev)

library(pheatmap)
pheatmap(as.dist(sample_cor), 
         annotation_row = colData(dev), 
         clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(1-sample_cor), 
         clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(1-sample_cor))

samples <- colData(sce)$sample_id
sample_levels <- unique(samples)
motif_names <- rownames(motif_dev_z)

# example: first two groups
s1 <- sample_levels[4]
s2 <- sample_levels[3]

in_s1 <- samples == s1
in_s2 <- samples == s2

mean_s1 <- rowMeans(motif_dev_z[, in_s1, drop = FALSE])
mean_s2 <- rowMeans(motif_dev_z[, in_s2, drop = FALSE])

pvals_samp <- vapply(seq_along(motif_names), function(i) {
  wilcox.test(
    motif_dev_z[i, in_s1],
    motif_dev_z[i, in_s2],
    alternative = "two.sided"
  )$p.value
}, numeric(1))

res_samples <- data.frame(
  motif      = motif_names,
  mean_s1    = mean_s1,
  mean_s2    = mean_s2,
  delta_mean = mean_s1 - mean_s2,
  pval       = pvals_samp,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
res_samples$padj <- p.adjust(res_samples$pval, method = "BH")

head(res_samples[order(res_samples$padj), ], 20)
```

```{r Get top 2K bins per sample to then use them to make DA and call motifs}
    DA = as.data.frame(rowData(scExp_2K_da))
    DA = DA %>% mutate(status = case_when(qval.group > 0.05 ~ "Not Sig",
                                                    abs(logFC.group) < 0.5 ~ "Not Sig",
                                        qval.group < 0.05 & logFC.group < -0.5 ~ "Down",
                                        qval.group < 0.05 & logFC.group > 0.5 ~ "Up"))
    pdf(file.path(maindir, "Output", "Volcano_Mouse_62neg_Tg_vs_WT_2Kbins.pdf"), width = 9)
    DA %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC.group, y = -log10(qval.group), fill = status)) + 
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.4, shape = 21, color = "black") +   
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype="dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype="dashed") +
   geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype="dashed") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightskyblue", "grey50", "tomato")) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(DA, -log10(qval.group) > 1.30103), aes(label = Gene), max.overlaps = 20, color = "black", size = 5) + 
    ggtitle("Volcano Plot - Mouse 62 neg - Tg vs WT")
    dev.off()
    
    write.csv(DA, file.path(maindir, "Output","Objects","DA_Mouse_62neg_Tg_vs_WT_2Kbins.csv"), row.names = F)
    
    ## Mouse_62hi_Tg_vs_WT
     scExp_2K_da = differential_analysis_scExp(scExp_2K, de_type = "custom", by = c("sample_id", "sample_id"),group = data.frame(group = c("m64_m68_Tg_62hi_tagged")), ref = data.frame(ref = c("m61_m66_WT_62hi_tagged")), prioritize_genes = F, method = "wilcox")
      DA = as.data.frame(rowData(scExp_2K_da))

    ggplot(aes(x = logFC.group, y = -log10(qval.group), fill = status)) +

    theme_classic() +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(DA, -log10(qval.group) > 1.30103), aes(label = Gene), max.overlaps = 20, color = "black", size = 5) +
```

```{r test of new DA methods}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(DESeq2)
library(stringr)

cts <- assay(scExp_1K, "counts")  # peaks x cells

# Build per-cell metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(scExp_1K))
meta$cell <- colnames(scExp_1K)

# CD62L label -> CD62Lneg / CD62Lpos
meta$CD62L <- ifelse(grepl("^CD62L\\+", meta$sample_id), "CD62Lpos",
              ifelse(grepl("^CD62L-",  meta$sample_id), "CD62Lneg", NA))

# drug label
meta$drug <- ifelse(grepl("with_drug", meta$sample_id), "with_drug",
             ifelse(grepl("no_drug",   meta$sample_id), "no_drug", NA))

# optional: block by library/replicate extracted from cell name
# (adjust the regex if your naming differs)
meta$replicate <- str_extract(meta$cell, "SCC-scChIC-CUR-PER-\\d+")

stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta$CD62L)), !any(is.na(meta$drug)))
meta$CD62L <- factor(meta$CD62L, levels = c("CD62Lneg","CD62Lpos"))
meta$drug  <- factor(meta$drug,  levels = c("no_drug","with_drug"))
meta$replicate <- factor(meta$replicate)  # may contain NAs; that's OK if you drop/replace below

# Helper to run DESeq2 within a CD62L group
run_deseq_within_cd62l <- function(cd62l_level, block_replicate = TRUE) {
  keep <- meta$CD62L == cd62l_level
  cts_sub <- cts[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub <- meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  # DESeq2 requires no NA in design variables
  if (block_replicate) {
    ok <- !is.na(meta_sub$replicate)
    cts_sub <- cts_sub[, ok, drop = FALSE]
    meta_sub <- meta_sub[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # Make DESeq2 colData with rownames matching columns of counts
  coldata <- data.frame(
    row.names  = colnames(cts_sub),
    drug       = droplevels(meta_sub$drug),
    replicate  = if (block_replicate) droplevels(meta_sub$replicate) else NULL
  )

  design_formula <- if (block_replicate) ~ replicate + drug else ~ drug

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(as.matrix(cts_sub)),  # ensure integer
    colData   = coldata,
    design    = design_formula
  )

  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("drug", "with_drug", "no_drug"))
  res <- res[order(res$padj), ]
  return(res)
}

# 1) drug vs no_drug within CD62Lneg
res_CD62Lneg_drug <- run_deseq_within_cd62l("CD62Lneg", block_replicate = F)

# 2) drug vs no_drug within CD62Lpos
res_CD62Lpos_drug <- run_deseq_within_cd62l("CD62Lpos", block_replicate = TRUE)

head(res_CD62Lneg_drug)
head(res_CD62Lpos_drug)

library(edgeR)

# example: cells-as-replicates within CD62Lneg (not ideal statistically, but runs)
keep <- meta$CD62L == "CD62Lneg"
keep <- meta$CD62L == "CD62Lpos"
y <- DGEList(counts = as.matrix(cts[, keep]))
group <- droplevels(meta$drug[keep])   # no_drug vs with_drug
design <- model.matrix(~ group)

y <- calcNormFactors(y)
y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)
res <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)  # drug effect
topTags(res)
diff_express = as.data.frame(topTags(res, n = nrow(cts)))


DA = diff_express
DA$ID = rownames(DA)

 DA = DA %>% mutate(status = case_when(FDR > 0.05 ~ "Not Sig",
                                                    abs(logFC) < 0.5 ~ "Not Sig",
                                        FDR < 0.05 & logFC < -0.5 ~ "Down",
                                        FDR < 0.05 & logFC > 0.5 ~ "Up"))
    DA %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR), fill = status)) + 
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.4, shape = 21, color = "black") +   
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype="dashed") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype="dashed") +
   geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype="dashed") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightskyblue", "grey50", "tomato"))

    DA <- DA %>%
  mutate(seqnames = gsub("(chr.*)_(.*)_(.*)", "\\1",ID),
         start = as.numeric(gsub("(chr.*)_(.*)_(.*)", "\\2",ID)), 
         end = as.numeric(gsub("(chr.*)_(.*)_(.*)", "\\3",ID)))
```
